effect.en: This unit can use the ‘Deathly Invocation’ ability even if a different friendly unit has already used it this turn, but units that have already been picked to be targets of that ability this turn cannot be picked to be targets.

declare.en: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

effect.en: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from wound rolls for the target’s attacks.

units.notes_en: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Vyrkos Retainer*.

declare.en: Pick a friendly **SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS HERO** wholly within 12" of this **MANIFESTATION** to be the target.

effect.en:
Pick 1 of the following:

• **Heal (D3)** the target.
• Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn. Then, this **MANIFESTATION** is banished and removed from play.

timing.en: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase

effect.en: Roll a dice. On a 3+, remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy non-**HERO** units and more than 3" from all enemy **HEROES**.

declare.en: Pick a friendly **Blood Knights** unit that charged this turn and is wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

effect.en: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of that unit’s **Templar Weapons** for the rest of the turn.

timing.en: Reaction: You declared a CHARGE ability for this unit

effect.en: You can re-roll the charge roll for that **CHARGE** ability. Then, before the charge move is made, you can pick a friendly **Blood Knights** unit that is not in combat, is wholly within 12" of this unit and has not used a **CHARGE** ability this turn to be the target. If this unit charges, then, immediately after the **CHARGE** ability used by this unit has been resolved, the target can immediately use the ‘Charge’ ability even if it is not your charge phase. In addition, you can re-roll charge rolls for the target this phase.

timing.en: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn

declare.en: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.

effect.en: Roll a number of dice equal to the target’s Health characteristic. For each 6, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
If this unit charged this turn, for the rest of the turn, subtract 5 from the control scores of enemy units while they are in combat with this unit.
While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Draconic Claws** is 5.

timing.en: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase

effect.en: If this unit is not in combat, remove it from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

Add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for this unit, to a maximum of 3. In addition, when this unit uses a **CHARGE** ability, it can pass through terrain features and enemy models as if it had **FLY**.
This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

timing.en: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn

effect.en: If any damage points were allocated to enemy units by this unit’s attacks this turn, **Heal (D3)** this unit and each other friendly **SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS MONSTER** unit wholly within 12" of this unit.

timing.en: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase

declare.en: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.

effect.en: Roll a dice. On a 3+, roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used by enemy units while they are in combat with this unit.
While each model in this unit is within 1" of any terrain features, this unit cannot be targeted by shooting attacks unless the attacking model is within 9" of it.

timing.en: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Enemy Turn

effect.en: This unit can use a **MOVE** ability as if it were your movement phase.

units.notes_en: This unit cannot be reinforced.

effect.en: Each time you make a run roll for a friendly **Deathrattle Skeletons** unit wholly within 12" of this unit, you can change that roll to a 4.

timing.en: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit

effect.en: Pick a friendly **Deathrattle Skeletons** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved.

units.notes_en: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Vyrkos Retainer.*

timing.en: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase

declare.en: Pick a friendly **DEATHRATTLE** unit within this unit’s combat range to be the target.

effect.en: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target’s melee weapons have **Crit (2 Hits)** for the rest of the turn.

timing.en: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit

effect.en: Pick a friendly non-**HERO DEATHRATTLE INFANTRY** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, add 1 to hit rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.

units.notes_en: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Deathrattle Overseer*.

effect.en:
If an attack made with this unit’s **King’s Relic Weapon** scores a critical hit, the target unit becomes **cursed** for the rest of the battle. Subtract 1 from save rolls for **cursed** units even if this unit has been destroyed.

**Designer’s Note**: *Multiple enemy units can become cursed by this ability but the same enemy unit cannot become cursed more than once.*

declare.en: Pick an objective or terrain feature within enemy territory.

effect.en: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by friendly **DEATHRATTLE** units while they are wholly within 6" of that objective or terrain feature.

units.notes_en: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Deathrattle Overseer*.

timing.en: Reaction: You declared a Fight ability for this unit

effect.en: Pick a friendly non-**HERO DEATHRATTLE CAVALRY** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved.
Add 1 to charge rolls for friendly **DEATHRATTLE CAVALRY** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

units.notes_en: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Deathrattle Overseer*.

effect.en:
If this unit is in a **SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS** army, pick a terrain feature within 3" of this unit, then roll a dice and apply the corresponding effect. You cannot pick the same terrain feature more than once per battle.

**1 *Cruel Hope*:** No effect.

**2-4 *Cursed Flesh*:** You can return D3 slain models to this unit.

**5-6 *Borrowed Power*:** Pick a friendly **SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS HERO** wholly within 12" of this unit that does not have an artefact of power. You can pick an artefact of power from the Soulblight Gravelords faction rules that no other friendly **HERO** has and give it to that **HERO**.
While this unit’s **Zondara Rivenheart** is on the battlefield, it has **WIZARD (1)**.

units.notes_en: This unit cannot be reinforced.
